keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Dusan Pavlovic (Jablonec) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Riga 1, Jablonec 0. Reginaldo Ramires (Riga) converts the penalty with a right footed shot to the bottom right corner.
First Half ends, Riga 1, Jablonec 0.
Substitution, Jablonec. Garang Kuol replaces Matej Polidar.
Second Half begins Riga 1, Jablonec 0.
Goal! Riga 1, Jablonec 1. Sebastian Nebyla (Jablonec) right footed shot from a difficult angle on the right to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Dominik Holly.
Maksims Tonisevs (Riga) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Jirí Sláma (Jablonec) is shown the yellow card.
Delay in match (Riga).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Jablonec. Lamin Jawo replaces Antonín Rusek.
Substitution, Jablonec. Daniel Soucek replaces Saidou Alioum.
Substitution, Riga. Caio Ferreira replaces Meïssa Diop.
Substitution, Jablonec. Nelson Okeke replaces Dominik Holly.
Substitution, Riga. Muhammed Badamosi replaces Reginaldo Ramires.
Substitution, Riga. Coli Saco replaces Raki Aouani.
Substitution, Jablonec. Filip Novák replaces Jirí Sláma.
Substitution, Riga. Samuel Pedro replaces Salah-Eddine Oulad.
Second Half ends, Riga 1, Jablonec 1.
